title: German Music Localization Specialist
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a German Music Localization Specialist based in Finland.

Join a dynamic localization project focused on making music-related content engaging, accurate, and culturally relevant for German-speaking audiences. In this role, you will refine, edit, and fact-check AI-generated content while ensuring it reflects authentic music terminology, current trends, and the language of contemporary pop culture. You will work across a variety of musical genres, including Pop, Rock, Hip-Hop, and K-Pop, helping deliver high-quality content across digital and audiovisual platforms. Combining creative writing expertise with cultural insight, you will improve content clarity, consistency, and overall editorial quality. This opportunity is ideal for a music enthusiast with a strong editorial voice who understands how language, artists, and cultural references connect with audiences. Your expertise will help shape more natural, engaging, and locally relevant music experiences.

Accountabilities

  • Content Review and Editing: Review, edit, refine, and fact-check music-related content in German, ensuring accuracy, clarity, coherence, and compliance with established editorial guidelines.

  • AI-Generated Content Enhancement: Improve US English source content generated by AI, refining its wording, structure, tone, and creative impact to produce engaging and natural German-language content.

  • Music Research and Fact-Checking: Conduct market-specific research into music terminology, artists, genres, industry conventions, and emerging trends to ensure content is accurate and up to date.

  • Cultural and Linguistic Adaptation: Adapt content to reflect the cultural nuances, language preferences, and expectations of the target audience while maintaining authenticity and relevance.

  • Editorial Quality Assurance: Ensure consistency, readability, and high editorial standards across digital and audiovisual platforms, following project-specific style guides and quality requirements.

  • Tone of Voice Optimisation: Tailor writing styles to different musical genres, audiences, and contexts, avoiding overly formal or artificial language in favour of an engaging, contemporary voice.

  • Content Feedback and Improvement: Provide clear, constructive feedback on written content, identify areas for improvement, and contribute to continuous quality enhancement.

  • Platform and Workflow Collaboration: Work with client-specific tools and editorial workflows to deliver consistent, high-quality content within established project requirements and timelines.

  • Pop Culture Awareness: Apply knowledge of mainstream music culture, popular artists, online trends, and contemporary expressions to ensure content resonates with its intended audience.

    • Requirements:

    • Copywriting Experience: Proven experience in copywriting, editing, or content creation, with the ability to produce polished, engaging, and audience-focused written material.

    • German Language Proficiency: Native-level fluency in German, with excellent grammar, spelling, punctuation, vocabulary, and stylistic awareness.

    • Music Content Expertise: Demonstrated experience writing or editing music-related content across multiple genres, with a strong understanding of the language and conventions used in music publishing and digital media.

    • Genre Knowledge: Deep familiarity with Pop, Rock, Hip-Hop, and K-Pop, including relevant artists, terminology, cultural references, and evolving trends.

    • Contemporary Music Awareness: Strong knowledge of the music industry and current music culture, including the ability to recognise relevant developments and distinguish accurate information from outdated or incorrect references.

    • Cultural and Editorial Sensitivity: Ability to adapt content to different musical contexts and audiences while maintaining cultural relevance, authenticity, and a natural tone of voice.

    • Pop Culture Fluency: A strong awareness of mainstream and emerging pop culture, including the expressions, references, and trends that resonate with contemporary audiences.

    • Attention to Detail: Excellent research, fact-checking, and proofreading skills, with the ability to identify inconsistencies and maintain accuracy across all content.

    • Adaptability and Creativity: Ability to adjust writing style and tone to meet different editorial requirements while keeping content engaging, clear, and natural.

    • Bonus Experience: Published music-related work in established publications such as Billboard, Rolling Stone, Pitchfork, NME, or comparable outlets.

    • Additional Advantage: Experience working with music streaming services, editorial platforms, music-focused applications, or similar digital content environments.

    • Audience-Specific Writing: Experience adapting content for Gen Z audiences and contemporary pop culture communities is an advantage.

    • Assessment: Willingness to complete a skills assessment covering German grammar and music subject-matter expertise.

      • Benefits:

      • Competitive Hourly Compensation: Earn between $30 and $35 per hour, depending on the applicable engagement terms.

      • Music-Focused Work: Apply your passion for music and editorial expertise to content covering popular genres, artists, and cultural trends.

      • Flexible Work Environment: Contribute to a localization project through established digital tools and remote collaboration workflows, subject to the project's specific working arrangements.

      • Creative Contribution: Help shape the quality, authenticity, and cultural relevance of music-related content for German-speaking audiences.

      • AI and Language Innovation: Gain exposure to AI-generated content refinement and quality assurance within a professional localization environment.

      • Specialist Development: Further develop your expertise in music editorial work, localization, cultural adaptation, and content quality evaluation.

title: Senior ICT biznis analitičar
description:
Postani deo ekipe Banca Intesa
Senior ICT biznis analitičar
Ko smo mi?
Mi smo tim od gotovo 3000 koleginica i kolega širom Srbije. Slavimo jedinstvenost i negujemo kulturu otvorenog feedback-a, jer samo tako možemo rasti i razvijati se zajedno.
Deo smo Intesa Sanpaolo, jedne od vodećih bankarskih grupa u Evropi, na tržištu Srbije smo 20 godina i poslujemo u više od 90 gradova naše zemlje. Verujemo da bez snažnih pojedinaca nema ni snažnih timova, ali i da samo jaki timovi mogu biti pravi oslonac i temelj za svaki individualni uspeh. Zajedno, svakodnevno brinemo o potrebama više od 1,3 miliona klijenata, gradeći čvrste odnose poverenja zasnovanih na ekspertizi i znanju.
Naše vrednosti
Verujemo u integritet i održivost našeg delovanja i poslovanja.
Brinemo o klijentima kroz izvrsnost naših usluga i proizvoda negujući dugoročne odnose. Stvaramo inovacije i dodatnu vrednost za pojedince, kompanije i zajednice u kojima poslujemo.
Gradimo održivu budućnost posvećenu očuvanju životne sredine, mladim generacijama i izgradnji istinski inkluzivnog društva.
Zašto baš Banca Intesa?
Svojim kolegama smo omogućili fleksibilno radno vreme i rad od kuće, kao i odlične prilike za razvoj kroz eksterne obuke, interne radionice i talent programe. Talentovanim kolegama pružamo priliku za internacionalnu karijeru. Brinemo o balansu, podstičemo zdrave životne navike i gradimo atmosferu dobre timske saradnje i podrške. Rad od kuće
Ti si odličan kandidat za ovu poziciju ako poseduješ:
  • Višu ili visoku stručnu spremu iz oblasti tehničko-tehnoloških, prirodno-matematičkih ili društvenih nauka
  • Višegodišnje iskustvo u definisanju i realizaciji zahteva za aplikativnim izmenama
  • Razumevanje tipične aplikativne arhitekture, tokove podataka, proces razvoja i održavanje aplikativnih rešenja
  • Sklonost ka timskom načinu rada
  • Dobro znanje engleskog jezika
  • Veštine kao što su komunikativnost, pouzdanost, sistematičnost i preciznost
Tvoje prednosti bi mogle da budu:
  • Poznavanje aplikativnog portfolia banke i poslovnih procesa
Šta ova uloga podrazumeva:
  • Učešće u definisanju poslovnih potreba za unapređenje poslovnih aplikacija
  • Biznis analizu i odobravanje zahteva koji se odnose na aplikativne izmene
  • Komunikaciju sa poslovnim korisnicima u okviru banke i vendorima koji učestvuju u razvoju i održavanju aplikativnih servisa
  • Koordinaciju komunikacije poslovnih korisnika sa ostalim ICT strukturama u vezi analize i implementacije izmena
  • Podršku poslovnim korisnicima prilikom testiranja i validacije izmena
  • Učešće u radu razvojnih projektnih timova banke
Ukoliko si zainteresovan/na za neku drugu poziciju u našoj banci, budi slobodan/na da nam prijavom na neki drugi otvoreni konkurs na našoj karijernoj strani, ostaviš svoju biografiju. Rado ćemo te kontaktirati ukoliko se pojavi potreba za tvojim profilom u željenom gradu, a u međuvremenu možeš nastaviti da pratiš naše konkurse i dodatno apliciraš ukoliko primetiš još neku poziciju koja ti je interesantna. Želimo ti puno sreće!
Proces selekcije
Trudimo se da proces selekcije bude jedno prijatno iskustvo u kome ćemo se bolje upoznati. Voleli bismo da saznamo više o tebi, ali i da ti damo što veći broj informacija koje bi ti bile potrebne da razumeš samu poziciju i način funkcionisanja organizacije.
Zato se proces selekcije sastoji iz nekoliko koraka:
1. Prijava
Prijavi se na neku od otvorenih pozicija tako što ćeš popuniti kratak formular i prikačiti svoj CV. Kolege iz HR-a u dogovoru sa kolegama za čiji tim apliciraš će pažljivo pogledati tvoju prijavu i obavestiti te ukoliko prelazimo na naredni korak.
2. Tehnički intervju
Na razgovoru koji ima za cilj da se obostrano informišemo i bliže upoznamo, naše kolege će detaljnije predstaviti samu poziciju i odgovoriti na tvoja pitanja. Povremeno kandidatima dajemo i kraći stručni test ili zadatak, a ukoliko se već u ovoj fazi interesovanja podudaraju i sa jedne i sa druge strane, onda ostaje još jedan korak.
3. HR test & intervju
Naredni korak u procesu selekcije sastoji se iz dva dela. Prvi deo čine online testovi logike i ličnosti, a drugi deo je online intervju u trajanju od oko pola sata.
4. Ponuda
Kolega iz HR-a će te obavestiti o ishodu ovog procesa i uvek nam je drago kada imamo pozitivnu informaciju i ponudu za tebe.
Ako vidiš sebe na ovoj poziciji i kao deo naše ekipe, čekamo tvoju prijavu!

title: German Music Localization Specialist
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a German Music Localization Specialist based in Germany.

Join a dynamic localization project focused on making music-related content engaging, accurate, and culturally relevant for German-speaking audiences. In this role, you will refine, edit, and fact-check AI-generated content while ensuring it reflects authentic music terminology, current trends, and the language of contemporary pop culture. You will work across a variety of musical genres, including Pop, Rock, Hip-Hop, and K-Pop, helping deliver high-quality content across digital and audiovisual platforms. Combining creative writing expertise with cultural insight, you will improve content clarity, consistency, and overall editorial quality. This opportunity is ideal for a music enthusiast with a strong editorial voice who understands how language, artists, and cultural references connect with audiences. Your expertise will help shape more natural, engaging, and locally relevant music experiences.

Accountabilities

  • Content Review and Editing: Review, edit, refine, and fact-check music-related content in German, ensuring accuracy, clarity, coherence, and compliance with established editorial guidelines.

  • AI-Generated Content Enhancement: Improve US English source content generated by AI, refining its wording, structure, tone, and creative impact to produce engaging and natural German-language content.

  • Music Research and Fact-Checking: Conduct market-specific research into music terminology, artists, genres, industry conventions, and emerging trends to ensure content is accurate and up to date.

  • Cultural and Linguistic Adaptation: Adapt content to reflect the cultural nuances, language preferences, and expectations of the target audience while maintaining authenticity and relevance.

  • Editorial Quality Assurance: Ensure consistency, readability, and high editorial standards across digital and audiovisual platforms, following project-specific style guides and quality requirements.

  • Tone of Voice Optimisation: Tailor writing styles to different musical genres, audiences, and contexts, avoiding overly formal or artificial language in favour of an engaging, contemporary voice.

  • Content Feedback and Improvement: Provide clear, constructive feedback on written content, identify areas for improvement, and contribute to continuous quality enhancement.

  • Platform and Workflow Collaboration: Work with client-specific tools and editorial workflows to deliver consistent, high-quality content within established project requirements and timelines.

  • Pop Culture Awareness: Apply knowledge of mainstream music culture, popular artists, online trends, and contemporary expressions to ensure content resonates with its intended audience.

    • Requirements:

    • Copywriting Experience: Proven experience in copywriting, editing, or content creation, with the ability to produce polished, engaging, and audience-focused written material.

    • German Language Proficiency: Native-level fluency in German, with excellent grammar, spelling, punctuation, vocabulary, and stylistic awareness.

    • Music Content Expertise: Demonstrated experience writing or editing music-related content across multiple genres, with a strong understanding of the language and conventions used in music publishing and digital media.

    • Genre Knowledge: Deep familiarity with Pop, Rock, Hip-Hop, and K-Pop, including relevant artists, terminology, cultural references, and evolving trends.

    • Contemporary Music Awareness: Strong knowledge of the music industry and current music culture, including the ability to recognise relevant developments and distinguish accurate information from outdated or incorrect references.

    • Cultural and Editorial Sensitivity: Ability to adapt content to different musical contexts and audiences while maintaining cultural relevance, authenticity, and a natural tone of voice.

    • Pop Culture Fluency: A strong awareness of mainstream and emerging pop culture, including the expressions, references, and trends that resonate with contemporary audiences.

    • Attention to Detail: Excellent research, fact-checking, and proofreading skills, with the ability to identify inconsistencies and maintain accuracy across all content.

    • Adaptability and Creativity: Ability to adjust writing style and tone to meet different editorial requirements while keeping content engaging, clear, and natural.

    • Bonus Experience: Published music-related work in established publications such as Billboard, Rolling Stone, Pitchfork, NME, or comparable outlets.

    • Additional Advantage: Experience working with music streaming services, editorial platforms, music-focused applications, or similar digital content environments.

    • Audience-Specific Writing: Experience adapting content for Gen Z audiences and contemporary pop culture communities is an advantage.

    • Assessment: Willingness to complete a skills assessment covering German grammar and music subject-matter expertise.

      • Benefits:

      • Competitive Hourly Compensation: Earn between $30 and $35 per hour, depending on the applicable engagement terms.

      • Music-Focused Work: Apply your passion for music and editorial expertise to content covering popular genres, artists, and cultural trends.

      • Flexible Work Environment: Contribute to a localization project through established digital tools and remote collaboration workflows, subject to the project's specific working arrangements.

      • Creative Contribution: Help shape the quality, authenticity, and cultural relevance of music-related content for German-speaking audiences.

      • AI and Language Innovation: Gain exposure to AI-generated content refinement and quality assurance within a professional localization environment.

      • Specialist Development: Further develop your expertise in music editorial work, localization, cultural adaptation, and content quality evaluation.

title: Director of Quality Assurance
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director of Quality Assurance based in the United States.

The Director of Quality Assurance will lead the evolution of quality engineering across a multi-tenant SaaS platform in a regulated healthcare environment. This strategic leadership role focuses on integrating AI-driven testing into the software development lifecycle while maintaining reliability, security, and regulatory compliance. You will scale modern test automation, optimize quality delivery, and support multiple product launches and continuous feature releases in parallel. Working closely with Engineering, Product, Security, DevOps, and Compliance, you will establish measurable quality standards that accelerate delivery without compromising customer trust. You will also lead a geographically distributed organization of in-house engineers and external vendor teams across multiple time zones. This is an opportunity to modernize quality engineering practices, develop high-performing teams, and help deliver dependable technology that advances human health.

Accountabilities:

The Director of Quality Assurance will define the quality strategy, lead organizational transformation, and ensure consistent delivery standards across the product portfolio. Key responsibilities include:

  • AI-Driven Quality Strategy: Integrate generative and predictive AI tools throughout the software development lifecycle, including AI-assisted test creation, requirements analysis, and automated risk-based test coverage.

  • Quality Throughput and Capacity: Scale testing capacity to match accelerated development output while protecting product quality. Track cycle time to release, escaped defect rates, automated test coverage, and full regression suite runtime.

  • Modern Test Automation: Lead the evolution of automation frameworks, prioritizing Playwright and AI-powered self-healing infrastructure to improve reliability and reduce maintenance. Address tenant isolation, data segregation, configuration-driven testing, and shared-schema regression risks.

  • Quality Organization Leadership: Oversee the QA function, ensuring continuous validation, platform stability, and alignment with modern quality engineering practices.

  • Regulatory and Compliance Quality: Maintain QA processes, documentation, and evidence that meet applicable healthcare and data protection requirements, including HIPAA, 21 CFR Part 11, GxP/CSV, SOC 2, and GDPR. Represent the quality function during internal and customer audits.

  • Validation of AI-Generated Test Assets: Establish review, approval, traceability, and evidence frameworks to ensure AI-assisted test artifacts meet the standards required in validated environments.

  • Security-Focused Testing: Partner with Security and DevOps to integrate SAST/DAST, dependency checks, vulnerability triage, and penetration testing into delivery pipelines. Ensure protected health information (PHI) is appropriately handled and de-identified in test environments.

  • Distributed Team and Vendor Management: Lead in-house and outsourced QA teams across time zones, establish consistent performance expectations, and maintain effective relationships with vendors, tool providers, and staffing partners.

  • Strategic Roadmap Execution: Deliver quality initiatives aligned with organizational priorities while improving the cost efficiency and scalability of the QA function.

  • Multi-Product Release Management: Own quality plans for concurrent launches, parallel release trains, phased deployments, and feature-flagged rollouts. Establish clear release-readiness criteria without creating unnecessary delivery bottlenecks.

  • Talent Development: Recruit, mentor, and develop QA leaders and engineers, building expertise in AI-driven testing and modern automation technologies.

  • Defect and Metrics Management: Monitor defects, establish continuous improvement processes, and provide Engineering leadership with actionable, data-driven insights into quality and organizational performance.

  • Budget and Resource Planning: Manage the QA budget and contribute to financial planning, capacity forecasting, and resource allocation.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Development, Product, Support, Compliance, Sales, Professional Services, executive stakeholders, and current or prospective customers.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate is an experienced quality engineering leader who combines technical depth with organizational leadership, strong regulatory knowledge, and a proven ability to modernize established QA practices. Required qualifications and capabilities include:

    • A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

    • At least 10 years of QA experience.

    • At least 5 years of management experience at Director level or in an equivalent senior leadership role.

    • Experience leading quality engineering within a regulated healthcare or life sciences environment, including exposure to HIPAA and FDA 21 CFR Part 11 requirements.

    • Direct experience building and leading QA for a multi-tenant SaaS product.

    • Demonstrated success introducing AI-assisted testing into an established organization.

    • Hands-on experience implementing AI tooling across the SDLC, including AI-assisted test generation and self-healing test runners.

    • Strong expertise in Playwright at scale within CI pipelines, modern web and API automation, and API or contract testing.

    • Sound judgment in determining when AI-generated testing assets are appropriate for validated and regulated environments.

    • Comprehensive understanding of the software development lifecycle and the integration of quality engineering into Agile, DevOps, and CI/CD workflows.

    • Proven ability to lead teams through significant tooling and process changes while maintaining delivery throughput and employee engagement.

    • Experience managing distributed and offshore QA teams, including in-house employees and vendor-supplied contractors, as well as selecting, onboarding, and overseeing external QA partners.

    • Strong executive communication skills, including presenting quality metrics, strategic progress, and performance insights to senior and C-level stakeholders.

    • Excellent attention to detail and a methodical approach to compliance, documentation, validation, and execution standards.

    • Ability to collaborate across multiple time zones and support a distributed organization.

    • US-based candidates are preferred. The role is remote, and some travel may be required.

      • Benefits:

      • Annual salary range of $185,000–$205,000 USD.

      • Medical, dental, vision, life, and long-term disability insurance.

      • 100% coverage of employee health insurance premiums.

      • 50% coverage of dependent health insurance premiums.

      • Flexible work schedules and locations, supporting work-life balance.

      • Remote, home-based working arrangement.

      • A collaborative environment that values innovation, continuous improvement, and high-quality customer experiences.

      • Opportunities to contribute to technology that supports advances in human health.

title: German Music Localization Specialist
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a German Music Localization Specialist based in Mexico.

Join a dynamic localization project focused on making music-related content engaging, accurate, and culturally relevant for German-speaking audiences. In this role, you will refine, edit, and fact-check AI-generated content while ensuring it reflects authentic music terminology, current trends, and the language of contemporary pop culture.   • Content Review and Editing: Review, edit, refine, and fact-check music-related content in German, ensuring accuracy, clarity, coherence, and compliance with established editorial guidelines.

  • Platform and Workflow Collaboration: Work with client-specific tools and editorial workflows to deliver consistent, high-quality content within established project requirements and timelines.

  • Pop Culture Awareness: Apply knowledge of mainstream music culture, popular artists, online trends, and contemporary expressions to ensure content resonates with its intended audience.

    • Requirements:

    • Copywriting Experience: Proven experience in copywriting, editing, or content creation, with the ability to produce polished, engaging, and audience-focused written material.

    • German Language Proficiency: Native-level fluency in German, with excellent grammar, spelling, punctuation, vocabulary, and stylistic awareness.

    • Music Content Expertise: Demonstrated experience writing or editing music-related content across multiple genres, with a strong understanding of the language and conventions used in music publishing and digital media.

    • Genre Knowledge: Deep familiarity with Pop, Rock, Hip-Hop, and K-Pop, including relevant artists, terminology, cultural references, and evolving trends.

    • Contemporary Music Awareness: Strong knowledge of the music industry and current music culture, including the ability to recognise relevant developments and distinguish accurate information from outdated or incorrect references.

    • Cultural and Editorial Sensitivity: Ability to adapt content to different musical contexts and audiences while maintaining cultural relevance, authenticity, and a natural tone of voice.

    • Pop Culture Fluency: A strong awareness of mainstream and emerging pop culture, including the expressions, references, and trends that resonate with contemporary audiences.

    • Attention to Detail: Excellent research, fact-checking, and proofreading skills, with the ability to identify inconsistencies and maintain accuracy across all content.

    • Adaptability and Creativity: Ability to adjust writing style and tone to meet different editorial requirements while keeping content engaging, clear, and natural.

    • Bonus Experience: Published music-related work in established publications such as Billboard, Rolling Stone, Pitchfork, NME, or comparable outlets.

    • Additional Advantage: Experience working with music streaming services, editorial platforms, music-focused applications, or similar digital content environments.

    • Assessment: Willingness to complete a skills assessment covering German grammar and music subject-matter expertise.

      • Benefits:

title: German Music Localization Specialist
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a German Music Localization Specialist based in Netherlands.

Join a dynamic localization project focused on making music-related content engaging, accurate, and culturally relevant for German-speaking audiences. In this role, you will refine, edit, and fact-check AI-generated content while ensuring it reflects authentic music terminology, current trends, and the language of contemporary pop culture. You will work across a variety of musical genres, including Pop, Rock, Hip-Hop, and K-Pop, helping deliver high-quality content across digital and audiovisual platforms. Combining creative writing expertise with cultural insight, you will improve content clarity, consistency, and overall editorial quality. This opportunity is ideal for a music enthusiast with a strong editorial voice who understands how language, artists, and cultural references connect with audiences. Your expertise will help shape more natural, engaging, and locally relevant music experiences.

Accountabilities

  • Content Review and Editing: Review, edit, refine, and fact-check music-related content in German, ensuring accuracy, clarity, coherence, and compliance with established editorial guidelines.

  • AI-Generated Content Enhancement: Improve US English source content generated by AI, refining its wording, structure, tone, and creative impact to produce engaging and natural German-language content.

  • Music Research and Fact-Checking: Conduct market-specific research into music terminology, artists, genres, industry conventions, and emerging trends to ensure content is accurate and up to date.

  • Cultural and Linguistic Adaptation: Adapt content to reflect the cultural nuances, language preferences, and expectations of the target audience while maintaining authenticity and relevance.

  • Editorial Quality Assurance: Ensure consistency, readability, and high editorial standards across digital and audiovisual platforms, following project-specific style guides and quality requirements.

  • Tone of Voice Optimisation: Tailor writing styles to different musical genres, audiences, and contexts, avoiding overly formal or artificial language in favour of an engaging, contemporary voice.

  • Content Feedback and Improvement: Provide clear, constructive feedback on written content, identify areas for improvement, and contribute to continuous quality enhancement.

  • Platform and Workflow Collaboration: Work with client-specific tools and editorial workflows to deliver consistent, high-quality content within established project requirements and timelines.

  • Pop Culture Awareness: Apply knowledge of mainstream music culture, popular artists, online trends, and contemporary expressions to ensure content resonates with its intended audience.

    • Requirements:

    • Copywriting Experience: Proven experience in copywriting, editing, or content creation, with the ability to produce polished, engaging, and audience-focused written material.

    • German Language Proficiency: Native-level fluency in German, with excellent grammar, spelling, punctuation, vocabulary, and stylistic awareness.

    • Music Content Expertise: Demonstrated experience writing or editing music-related content across multiple genres, with a strong understanding of the language and conventions used in music publishing and digital media.

    • Genre Knowledge: Deep familiarity with Pop, Rock, Hip-Hop, and K-Pop, including relevant artists, terminology, cultural references, and evolving trends.

    • Contemporary Music Awareness: Strong knowledge of the music industry and current music culture, including the ability to recognise relevant developments and distinguish accurate information from outdated or incorrect references.

    • Cultural and Editorial Sensitivity: Ability to adapt content to different musical contexts and audiences while maintaining cultural relevance, authenticity, and a natural tone of voice.

    • Pop Culture Fluency: A strong awareness of mainstream and emerging pop culture, including the expressions, references, and trends that resonate with contemporary audiences.

    • Attention to Detail: Excellent research, fact-checking, and proofreading skills, with the ability to identify inconsistencies and maintain accuracy across all content.

    • Adaptability and Creativity: Ability to adjust writing style and tone to meet different editorial requirements while keeping content engaging, clear, and natural.

    • Bonus Experience: Published music-related work in established publications such as Billboard, Rolling Stone, Pitchfork, NME, or comparable outlets.

    • Additional Advantage: Experience working with music streaming services, editorial platforms, music-focused applications, or similar digital content environments.

    • Audience-Specific Writing: Experience adapting content for Gen Z audiences and contemporary pop culture communities is an advantage.

    • Assessment: Willingness to complete a skills assessment covering German grammar and music subject-matter expertise.

      • Benefits:

      • Competitive Hourly Compensation: Earn between $30 and $35 per hour, depending on the applicable engagement terms.

      • Music-Focused Work: Apply your passion for music and editorial expertise to content covering popular genres, artists, and cultural trends.

      • Flexible Work Environment: Contribute to a localization project through established digital tools and remote collaboration workflows, subject to the project's specific working arrangements.

      • Creative Contribution: Help shape the quality, authenticity, and cultural relevance of music-related content for German-speaking audiences.

      • AI and Language Innovation: Gain exposure to AI-generated content refinement and quality assurance within a professional localization environment.

      • Specialist Development: Further develop your expertise in music editorial work, localization, cultural adaptation, and content quality evaluation.

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. title: English to French (France) Linguist for Life Sciences
description:
About Welo Life Sciences

Welo Life Sciences, a Welo Global brand, is a specialized language and technology partner serving pharmaceutical, CRO, and medical device organizations operating in regulated global markets. We deliver regulator-ready translation, linguistic validation, and localization solutions that support clinical trials, pharmacovigilance, regulatory affairs, labeling, and global commercialization. Our approach combines subject matter expertise with ISO-certified quality processes and technology-enabled workflows designed to integrate seamlessly into life sciences operations. With extensive experience supporting global product development and post-market requirements, Welo Life Sciences helps organizations accelerate timelines, protect data integrity, and maintain compliance across languages and regions. All solutions are delivered within a secure, audit-ready framework supported by seven ISO certifications.


About the Role

We are looking for experienced English into French (France) linguists specializing in Clinical-trials, Pharmacovigilance and Regulatory document translation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Translate clinical research, regulatory and pharmacovigilance documents from English to French.
  • Perform Machine Translation Post-Editing (MTPE) on machine-translated safety content.
  • Perform Copy Edit (translation review) of translated/post-edited content for accuracy, tone, and consistency.
  • Meet strict, non-extendable turnaround times on time-sensitive content.
  • Work within the client's CAT tool environment (XTM/Phrase), also Track Changes in Microsoft Word following project-specific setup instructions.

Field of Expertise

  • Clinical Research Documents (protocols and synopses, IB, ICF, Patient Sheets, Patient Diaries)
  • Regulatory Documents (SmPC, PIL, Labels, CTD Modules)
  • Pharmacovigilance Documents (PSUR, DSUR, RMP, SAE and AE)

Must-Have Criteria

  • Applicant must meet at least one of the following criteria:

Education

  • A degree in Translation, Linguistics, or Language Studies (or an equivalent degree) or
  • Recognized graduate qualification in any other field, plus a minimum of two years of full-time professional experience in translation or
  • A minimum of five years of full-time professional experience in translation

Relevant translation experience

  • At least two years of practical translation experience, specifically with life sciences (clinical trials and pharmacovigilance) and medical documents

Technical Skills

  • Familiarity with CAT tools (XTM/Phrase), License will be provided.
  • Familiarity with Track Changes in Microsoft Word

Nice-to-Have

  • Degree in Medicine, Biology, Biochemistry, Clinical Research, Translation, Linguistics, Philology or similar
  • In-house industry experience at a CRO or pharmaceutical company.

Before Applying

Please note there will be an assessment as part of our onboarding and quality procedure, please only apply if you're willing to complete our assessment.
Please ensure your latest English CV accurately reflects your Life Sciences and Medical translation experience, including years of experience specifically in Life Sciences, the document types you’ve translated, CAT tool you've used, and relevant details also your contact information (email AND phone number).
Beware of recruitment scams. Welo Global and all of its brands never recruit through direct messages on social media or WhatsApp, and never asks candidates to pay money for a job. Official emails come only from @welocalize.com, @welodata.ai, or @hire.lever.co, and all applications go through jobs.lever.co/weloglobal. Be wary of unexpected offers, generic email addresses (such as Gmail or Yahoo), and requests for fees or sensitive information. Report suspicious messages and learn more: Recognizing Scams and Confirming Legitimate Welocalize Communications – Welo Global
We look forward to receiving your application!

title: German Music Localization Specialist
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a German Music Localization Specialist based in Italy.

Join a dynamic localization project focused on making music-related content engaging, accurate, and culturally relevant for German-speaking audiences. In this role, you will refine, edit, and fact-check AI-generated content while ensuring it reflects authentic music terminology, current trends, and the language of contemporary pop culture. You will work across a variety of musical genres, including Pop, Rock, Hip-Hop, and K-Pop, helping deliver high-quality content across digital and audiovisual platforms. Combining creative writing expertise with cultural insight, you will improve content clarity, consistency, and overall editorial quality. This opportunity is ideal for a music enthusiast with a strong editorial voice who understands how language, artists, and cultural references connect with audiences. Your expertise will help shape more natural, engaging, and locally relevant music experiences.

Accountabilities

  • Content Review and Editing: Review, edit, refine, and fact-check music-related content in German, ensuring accuracy, clarity, coherence, and compliance with established editorial guidelines.

  • Content Feedback and Improvement: Provide clear, constructive feedback on written content, identify areas for improvement, and contribute to continuous quality enhancement.

  • Platform and Workflow Collaboration: Work with client-specific tools and editorial workflows to deliver consistent, high-quality content within established project requirements and timelines.

  • Pop Culture Awareness: Apply knowledge of mainstream music culture, popular artists, online trends, and contemporary expressions to ensure content resonates with its intended audience.

    • Requirements:

    • Copywriting Experience: Proven experience in copywriting, editing, or content creation, with the ability to produce polished, engaging, and audience-focused written material.

    • German Language Proficiency: Native-level fluency in German, with excellent grammar, spelling, punctuation, vocabulary, and stylistic awareness.

    • Music Content Expertise: Demonstrated experience writing or editing music-related content across multiple genres, with a strong understanding of the language and conventions used in music publishing and digital media.

    • Genre Knowledge: Deep familiarity with Pop, Rock, Hip-Hop, and K-Pop, including relevant artists, terminology, cultural references, and evolving trends.

    • Contemporary Music Awareness: Strong knowledge of the music industry and current music culture, including the ability to recognise relevant developments and distinguish accurate information from outdated or incorrect references.

    • Cultural and Editorial Sensitivity: Ability to adapt content to different musical contexts and audiences while maintaining cultural relevance, authenticity, and a natural tone of voice.

    • Pop Culture Fluency: A strong awareness of mainstream and emerging pop culture, including the expressions, references, and trends that resonate with contemporary audiences.

    • Attention to Detail: Excellent research, fact-checking, and proofreading skills, with the ability to identify inconsistencies and maintain accuracy across all content.

    • Adaptability and Creativity: Ability to adjust writing style and tone to meet different editorial requirements while keeping content engaging, clear, and natural.

    • Bonus Experience: Published music-related work in established publications such as Billboard, Rolling Stone, Pitchfork, NME, or comparable outlets.

    • Additional Advantage: Experience working with music streaming services, editorial platforms, music-focused applications, or similar digital content environments.

    • Audience-Specific Writing: Experience adapting content for Gen Z audiences and contemporary pop culture communities is an advantage.

    • Assessment: Willingness to complete a skills assessment covering German grammar and music subject-matter expertise.

      • Benefits:

      • Music-Focused Work: Apply your passion for music and editorial expertise to content covering popular genres, artists, and cultural trends.

      • Flexible Work Environment: Contribute to a localization project through established digital tools and remote collaboration workflows, subject to the project's specific working arrangements.

  • Evaluate language outputs against established quality standards and project-specific requirements.

  • Identify and correct subtle linguistic errors, unnatural expressions, awkward phrasing, and cultural inconsistencies in your native language.

  • Act as a key quality checkpoint during production, helping prevent recurring language issues and maintain consistent standards.

  • Analyze quality trends and recurring errors to identify opportunities for improvement across AI data tasks.

    • Previous hands-on experience in human data evaluation, data annotation, or a related quality assurance activity.

    • Verified English proficiency at C1 or C2 level.

    • Native-level proficiency in the target language, with an excellent understanding of grammar, idiomatic expressions, and cultural nuance.

    • Strong analytical skills and the ability to identify subtle language inconsistencies and unnatural phrasing.

The role involves developing data-driven user interfaces using Angular, working with SQL databases, configuring and managing Apache web servers, developing and maintaining PHP applications, implementing reliable computer-to-computer database synchronisation, and maintaining appropriate security measures and digital certificates.

The successful candidate will have strong database development skills, a thorough understanding of web server configuration and management, practical experience with application and communications security, and good working knowledge of both Windows and Linux operating systems.

Angular Web Development

  • Ability to integrate frontend applications with backend services and databases.
  • Experience developing clear and effective interfaces for displaying operational and numerical data.

SQL Database Development

  • Deep knowledge of SQL databases, including database design, development, administration, and optimisation.
  • Strong understanding of SQL queries, relational data structures, indexing, and efficient data retrieval.
  • Experience integrating web applications with SQL databases.
  • Ability to diagnose and resolve database performance, connectivity, and data integrity issues.

Apache Web Server and PHP Configuration and Management

  • Ability to diagnose and resolve web server, PHP application, connectivity, and configuration issues.
  • Understanding of web server security, performance optimisation, and reliable application hosting.
  • Experience implementing appropriate security configurations for Apache and PHP applications.

Computer-to-Computer Database Synchronisation

  • Experience implementing computer-to-computer database synchronisation protocols and mechanisms.
  • Understanding of synchronising data between databases hosted on separate computers or systems.
  • Ability to maintain data consistency and integrity across synchronised databases.
  • Understanding of synchronisation conflicts, duplicate records, error handling, and recovery from interrupted communications.
  • Experience developing or configuring reliable data exchange mechanisms between distributed systems.
  • Ability to troubleshoot database synchronisation failures and communication issues between computers.
  • Understanding of secure data transmission and authentication between connected systems.

Windows and Linux Operating Systems

  • Good working knowledge of both Microsoft Windows and Linux operating systems.
  • Experience configuring and troubleshooting applications and services across Windows and Linux environments.
  • Understanding of file systems, permissions, networking, and system configuration.
  • Ability to investigate application, database, and connectivity issues across different operating systems.
  • Familiarity with command-line tools and system administration.
  • Experience deploying and maintaining web applications and associated services in Windows and Linux environments.
  • Understanding of operating system security, access controls, software updates, and secure configuration.

Data Visualisation and Charting

  • Experience implementing charts, graphs, historical trends, and other data visualisations using suitable charting libraries.
  • Ability to present numerical and operational data clearly and effectively.
  • Experience displaying structured datasets within web-based HMI applications.
  • Understanding of how to present complex datasets in an accessible and meaningful format.


JSON and Data Handling

  • Strong familiarity with JSON data structures and formats.

  • Experience handling data exchanged between frontend applications, backend services, and databases.
  • Understanding of data structures and formats used to transfer information between different applications and systems.

Join a dynamic localization project focused on making music-related content engaging, accurate, and culturally relevant for German-speaking audiences. In this role, you will refine, edit, and fact-check AI-generated content while ensuring it reflects authentic music terminology, current trends, and the language of contemporary pop culture.   • Platform and Workflow Collaboration: Work with client-specific tools and editorial workflows to deliver consistent, high-quality content within established project requirements and timelines.

title: Senior Project Manager - Medical Communications
description:
About Avalere Health

United by one profound purpose: to reach EVERY PATIENT POSSIBLE. At Avalere Health, we ensure every patient is identified, treated, supported, and cared for. Equally. Our Advisory, Medical, and Marketing teams come together – powerfully and intentionally – to forge unconventional connections, building a future where healthcare is not a barrier and no patient is left behind.

Achieving our mission starts with providing enriching, purpose-driven careers for our team that empower them to make a tangible impact on patient lives. We are committed to creating a culture where our employees are empowered to bring their whole selves to work and tap into the power of diverse backgrounds and skillsets to play a part in making a difference for every patient, everywhere.

Our flexible approach to working allows our global teams to decide where they want to work, whether in-office or at home based on team and client need. Major city hubs in London, Manchester, Washington, D.C., and New York, and smaller offices globally, serve as collaboration hubs allowing our teams to come together when it matters. Homeworkers are equally supported, with dedicated social opportunities and resources.

Our inclusive culture is at the heart of everything we do. We proudly support our employees in bringing their whole selves to work with our six Employee Network Groups – Diverse Ability, Family, Gender, LGBTQ+, Mental Health, and Race/Ethnicity. These groups provide opportunities to promote diversity, equity, and inclusion and to connect, learn, and socialise through regular meetings and programs of activity. We are an accredited Fertility Friendly employer with our Fertility Policy, enhanced parental leave, and culture of flexibility ensuring every employee feels supported across their family planning journey and can work in a way that suits their family’s needs.

We are deeply invested in supporting professional growth for our employees through day-to-day career experiences, access to thousands of on-demand training sessions, regular career conversations, and the opportunity for global, cross-capability career moves.

We take pride in being part of the Disability Confident Scheme. This helps make sure you can be interviewed fairly if you have a disability, long term health condition, or are neurodiverse. If you'd like to apply and need adjustments made, you can let us know in your application.

About The role
As a Senior Project Manager, you’ll take ownership of complex projects and larger accounts within our Medical capability, with on Medical Affairs. This role brings together people, priorities and timelines to deliver work that achieves meaningful outcomes for our clients. Working with a high degree of autonomy, you’ll be a trusted client contact and a central point of connection for internal teams and external partners, keeping projects on track, on budget and aligned to agreed objectives.

You’ll combine confident communication with strong project and financial management skills, building collaborative relationships across Client Service, Editorial and wider teams. Along the way, you’ll anticipate challenges, create clarity and help colleagues do their best work, with opportunities to share your experience and support the development of others.

What You'll Do

  • Manage all aspects of assigned projects from a project management and financial perspective, ensuring successful planning, management, execution and outcome
  • Ensure both clients and internal stakeholders are kept informed and regularly updated on project progress with any concerns being flagged to appropriate department leads in a timely manner
  • Actively drive timelines and act as an internal information hub for the account
  • Actively manage project finances to achieve Avalere Health KPIs and proactively discuss any corrective courses of action with client and internal team
  • Where possible identify, and generate, opportunities with existing and new accounts.

  • The range of tasks which a SPM may be asked to do includes but is not limited to:
  • budget development and reconciliation
  • updating PM tools and running regular reports
  • reviewing project management processes and finding ways to resolve
  • timeline/schedule development and updating
  • providing internal and external financial information
  • invoicing clients; tracking and phasing projects
  • traffic management; updating status sheets
  • driving internal and client status calls
  • mentoring and guiding best practice
  • providing project feedback and input to action plans.

About You

  • Demonstrate a minimum of 5+ years of experience in client facing project management roles within a Medical Communications agency.
  • Experience working on Medical Affairs accounts is highly preferred
What we can offer

You'll receive up to a 7% pension contribution, life insurance, income protection, and private medical insurance for peace of mind. Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including flexible hybrid working, along with the option to work from anywhere across the globe two weeks each year. We provide 25 days of annual leave plus two personal well-being days, along with gifted end-of-year holidays and an early Summer Friday finish in June, July, and August.

Access free counselling through our employee assistance program, as well as personalized health support. Enhanced maternity, paternity, family leave, and fertility policies provide support across every stage of your family-planning journey, as well as on-demand support from our partner Peppy. You can also benefit from continuous opportunities to professionally develop with on-demand training, support, and global mobility opportunities across the business.

We encourage all applicants to read our candidate privacy notice before applying to Avalere Health.

title: Functional & Database Test Analyst
description:
Functional & Database Test Analyst

Location: London

The Opportunity

Are you an experienced QA professional with strong functional testing and SQL skills? We’re looking for a Functional & Database Test Analyst to help ensure applications perform as expected and business-critical data is accurate, consistent and reliable.

Working closely with business analysts, developers, product owners and end users, you’ll play a key role in validating application functionality, testing end-to-end business workflows and investigating data issues across integrated systems.

This is an opportunity to apply your technical testing expertise within a financial services environment, helping deliver high-quality applications that meet complex business and data requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyse business requirements, functional specifications, user stories and data mappings to establish clear testing objectives and acceptance criteria.
  • Design and maintain test plans, scenarios, test cases and test data covering positive and negative scenarios, boundary conditions and exception handling.
  • Execute smoke, sanity, system, integration, regression and end-to-end testing across applications and connected systems.
  • Write and execute SQL queries using joins, subqueries, grouping and aggregate functions to validate data, calculations and business rules.
  • Perform source-to-target data reconciliation, identifying missing, duplicate, inaccurate or inconsistent records and verifying data transformation rules.
  • Investigate application and data issues using system behaviour, logs and database records, documenting defects with clear reproduction steps and supporting evidence.
  • Work with development teams to triage defects, verify fixes and support effective resolution.
  • Maintain traceability between requirements, test cases and defects, assess the impact of changes, and report test progress, coverage, blockers and release risks.
  • Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by preparing business scenarios, investigating reported issues and collaborating with business stakeholders throughout the delivery lifecycle.

About You

You’ll be a detail-oriented and analytical testing professional who can combine functional testing expertise with strong database validation skills. You’ll be comfortable working with technical teams and business stakeholders to understand requirements, investigate issues and deliver reliable results.

You’ll ideally bring:

  • A bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering or a related discipline, alongside relevant experience in manual functional and database testing.
  • Financial services domain knowledge, particularly in one or more of the following areas: finance, investments, portfolio management, portfolio construction, Outsourced Chief Investment Officer (OCIO) applications, trading, cash management, compliance, risk or capital markets.
  • A strong understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC), test design techniques, defect management and Agile Scrum methodologies.
  • The ability to translate business requirements and acceptance criteria into effective test scenarios, expected results and comprehensive test coverage.
  • Hands-on experience testing application functionality, business workflows, calculations, role-based access and system integrations.
  • Experience validating data across applications, reports, database tables and integrated systems, including source-to-target reconciliation.
  • Strong SQL skills, including joins, subqueries, grouping and aggregate functions, with experience using a relational database such as Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL or MySQL.
  • A practical understanding of database tables, keys, relationships, constraints and transactions, with the ability to investigate data integrity issues.
  • Experience using Jira, Azure DevOps or equivalent tools for test management, defect tracking and progress reporting.
  • Experience supporting UAT and collaborating effectively with business analysts, developers, product owners and business users.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, excellent attention to detail, clear communication and the ability to manage competing priorities.

Desirable Experience

Experience in any of the following areas would be an advantage:

  • Testing stored procedures, ETL processes, data migrations or data warehouse workflows.
  • API testing using tools such as Postman or Bruno.
  • Functional test automation.

title: Senior Software Developer
description:
We're looking for an experienced Senior Software Developer to join a highly technical engineering team developing systems that directly support trading strategies, automated trading, and quantitative research.

This opportunity suits a strong C#/.NET engineer who enjoys complex technical challenges, performance-critical development and influencing how software is designed and built. Working across greenfield projects and established platforms, you'll take ownership of significant development work and help shape architecture, technical direction, and engineering standards. You'll collaborate closely with quantitative researchers, traders, and experienced engineers, translating complex requirements into reliable, scalable software.
This is a full-time office based role in central London.

The Role:

  • Design and develop high-performance applications using C# and modern .NET.
  • Own complex projects from initial requirements and technical design through to production.
  • Shape architecture and contribute to key technical decisions.
  • Build scalable systems supporting trading, research and data-intensive applications.
  • Develop and optimise relational database solutions using SQL Server, Oracle or similar technologies.
  • Investigate performance bottlenecks and improve application and database efficiency.
  • Apply multithreading, concurrency and asynchronous programming to demanding engineering problems.
  • Strengthen software quality through code reviews, automated testing and continuous integration.
  • Mentor other developers and help maintain high engineering standards.

Skills Required:

  • At least five years' commercial software development experience, with strong expertise in C# and modern .NET.
  • Excellent understanding of object-oriented programming, software design principles and architecture.
  • Experience delivering production applications where performance, reliability and scalability are essential.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience with relational databases.
  • A thorough understanding of the full software development lifecycle.
  • Strong analytical skills and a practical approach to solving complex problems.
  • Clear communication skills and the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical colleagues.
  • A degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

Desirable Experience:

  • Low-latency, high-throughput, multithreaded or parallel systems.
  • Network programming using TCP/IP or UDP.
  • Distributed systems and service-oriented architectures.
  • Performance profiling and optimisation.
  • Windows development technologies, Git and modern development workflows.
  • Financial markets, algorithmic trading or quantitative research.
  • Working directly with quantitative analysts, researchers, traders or data scientists.

Why Apply?

This is an opportunity to take on technically demanding work with a direct connection to trading and research. You'll have meaningful ownership, influence over engineering decisions and the chance to build high-performance software alongside colleagues with deep technical and quantitative expertise.

If you're an experienced C#/.NET developer looking for technical depth and the opportunity to shape complex systems, we'd like to hear from you.

Spectrum IT Recruitment (South) Limited is acting as an Employment Agency in relation to this vacancy.

title: German Music Localization Specialist
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a German Music Localization Specialist based in Australia.

Join a dynamic localization project focused on making music-related content engaging, accurate, and culturally relevant for German-speaking audiences. In this role, you will refine, edit, and fact-check AI-generated content while ensuring it reflects authentic music terminology, current trends, and the language of contemporary pop culture. You will work across a variety of musical genres, including Pop, Rock, Hip-Hop, and K-Pop, helping deliver high-quality content across digital and audiovisual platforms. Combining creative writing expertise with cultural insight, you will improve content clarity, consistency, and overall editorial quality. This opportunity is ideal for a music enthusiast with a strong editorial voice who understands how language, artists, and cultural references connect with audiences. Your expertise will help shape more natural, engaging, and locally relevant music experiences.

Accountabilities

  • Content Review and Editing: Review, edit, refine, and fact-check music-related content in German, ensuring accuracy, clarity, coherence, and compliance with established editorial guidelines.

  • AI-Generated Content Enhancement: Improve US English source content generated by AI, refining its wording, structure, tone, and creative impact to produce engaging and natural German-language content.

  • Music Research and Fact-Checking: Conduct market-specific research into music terminology, artists, genres, industry conventions, and emerging trends to ensure content is accurate and up to date.

  • Cultural and Linguistic Adaptation: Adapt content to reflect the cultural nuances, language preferences, and expectations of the target audience while maintaining authenticity and relevance.

  • Editorial Quality Assurance: Ensure consistency, readability, and high editorial standards across digital and audiovisual platforms, following project-specific style guides and quality requirements.

  • Tone of Voice Optimisation: Tailor writing styles to different musical genres, audiences, and contexts, avoiding overly formal or artificial language in favour of an engaging, contemporary voice.

  • Content Feedback and Improvement: Provide clear, constructive feedback on written content, identify areas for improvement, and contribute to continuous quality enhancement.

  • Platform and Workflow Collaboration: Work with client-specific tools and editorial workflows to deliver consistent, high-quality content within established project requirements and timelines.

  • Pop Culture Awareness: Apply knowledge of mainstream music culture, popular artists, online trends, and contemporary expressions to ensure content resonates with its intended audience.

    • Requirements:

    • Copywriting Experience: Proven experience in copywriting, editing, or content creation, with the ability to produce polished, engaging, and audience-focused written material.

    • German Language Proficiency: Native-level fluency in German, with excellent grammar, spelling, punctuation, vocabulary, and stylistic awareness.

    • Music Content Expertise: Demonstrated experience writing or editing music-related content across multiple genres, with a strong understanding of the language and conventions used in music publishing and digital media.

    • Genre Knowledge: Deep familiarity with Pop, Rock, Hip-Hop, and K-Pop, including relevant artists, terminology, cultural references, and evolving trends.

    • Contemporary Music Awareness: Strong knowledge of the music industry and current music culture, including the ability to recognise relevant developments and distinguish accurate information from outdated or incorrect references.

    • Cultural and Editorial Sensitivity: Ability to adapt content to different musical contexts and audiences while maintaining cultural relevance, authenticity, and a natural tone of voice.

    • Pop Culture Fluency: A strong awareness of mainstream and emerging pop culture, including the expressions, references, and trends that resonate with contemporary audiences.

    • Attention to Detail: Excellent research, fact-checking, and proofreading skills, with the ability to identify inconsistencies and maintain accuracy across all content.

    • Adaptability and Creativity: Ability to adjust writing style and tone to meet different editorial requirements while keeping content engaging, clear, and natural.

    • Bonus Experience: Published music-related work in established publications such as Billboard, Rolling Stone, Pitchfork, NME, or comparable outlets.

    • Additional Advantage: Experience working with music streaming services, editorial platforms, music-focused applications, or similar digital content environments.

    • Audience-Specific Writing: Experience adapting content for Gen Z audiences and contemporary pop culture communities is an advantage.

    • Assessment: Willingness to complete a skills assessment covering German grammar and music subject-matter expertise.

      • Benefits:

      • Competitive Hourly Compensation: Earn between $30 and $35 per hour, depending on the applicable engagement terms.

      • Music-Focused Work: Apply your passion for music and editorial expertise to content covering popular genres, artists, and cultural trends.

      • Flexible Work Environment: Contribute to a localization project through established digital tools and remote collaboration workflows, subject to the project's specific working arrangements.

      • Creative Contribution: Help shape the quality, authenticity, and cultural relevance of music-related content for German-speaking audiences.

      • AI and Language Innovation: Gain exposure to AI-generated content refinement and quality assurance within a professional localization environment.

      • Specialist Development: Further develop your expertise in music editorial work, localization, cultural adaptation, and content quality evaluation.

title: German Music Localization Specialist
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a German Music Localization Specialist based in United States.

Join a dynamic localization project focused on making music-related content engaging, accurate, and culturally relevant for German-speaking audiences. In this role, you will refine, edit, and fact-check AI-generated content while ensuring it reflects authentic music terminology, current trends, and the language of contemporary pop culture. You will work across a variety of musical genres, including Pop, Rock, Hip-Hop, and K-Pop, helping deliver high-quality content across digital and audiovisual platforms. Combining creative writing expertise with cultural insight, you will improve content clarity, consistency, and overall editorial quality. This opportunity is ideal for a music enthusiast with a strong editorial voice who understands how language, artists, and cultural references connect with audiences. Your expertise will help shape more natural, engaging, and locally relevant music experiences.

Accountabilities

  • Content Review and Editing: Review, edit, refine, and fact-check music-related content in German, ensuring accuracy, clarity, coherence, and compliance with established editorial guidelines.

  • AI-Generated Content Enhancement: Improve US English source content generated by AI, refining its wording, structure, tone, and creative impact to produce engaging and natural German-language content.

  • Music Research and Fact-Checking: Conduct market-specific research into music terminology, artists, genres, industry conventions, and emerging trends to ensure content is accurate and up to date.

  • Cultural and Linguistic Adaptation: Adapt content to reflect the cultural nuances, language preferences, and expectations of the target audience while maintaining authenticity and relevance.

  • Editorial Quality Assurance: Ensure consistency, readability, and high editorial standards across digital and audiovisual platforms, following project-specific style guides and quality requirements.

  • Tone of Voice Optimisation: Tailor writing styles to different musical genres, audiences, and contexts, avoiding overly formal or artificial language in favour of an engaging, contemporary voice.

  • Content Feedback and Improvement: Provide clear, constructive feedback on written content, identify areas for improvement, and contribute to continuous quality enhancement.

  • Platform and Workflow Collaboration: Work with client-specific tools and editorial workflows to deliver consistent, high-quality content within established project requirements and timelines.

  • Pop Culture Awareness: Apply knowledge of mainstream music culture, popular artists, online trends, and contemporary expressions to ensure content resonates with its intended audience.

    • Requirements:

    • Copywriting Experience: Proven experience in copywriting, editing, or content creation, with the ability to produce polished, engaging, and audience-focused written material.

    • German Language Proficiency: Native-level fluency in German, with excellent grammar, spelling, punctuation, vocabulary, and stylistic awareness.

    • Music Content Expertise: Demonstrated experience writing or editing music-related content across multiple genres, with a strong understanding of the language and conventions used in music publishing and digital media.

    • Genre Knowledge: Deep familiarity with Pop, Rock, Hip-Hop, and K-Pop, including relevant artists, terminology, cultural references, and evolving trends.

    • Contemporary Music Awareness: Strong knowledge of the music industry and current music culture, including the ability to recognise relevant developments and distinguish accurate information from outdated or incorrect references.

    • Cultural and Editorial Sensitivity: Ability to adapt content to different musical contexts and audiences while maintaining cultural relevance, authenticity, and a natural tone of voice.

    • Pop Culture Fluency: A strong awareness of mainstream and emerging pop culture, including the expressions, references, and trends that resonate with contemporary audiences.

    • Attention to Detail: Excellent research, fact-checking, and proofreading skills, with the ability to identify inconsistencies and maintain accuracy across all content.

    • Adaptability and Creativity: Ability to adjust writing style and tone to meet different editorial requirements while keeping content engaging, clear, and natural.

    • Bonus Experience: Published music-related work in established publications such as Billboard, Rolling Stone, Pitchfork, NME, or comparable outlets.

    • Additional Advantage: Experience working with music streaming services, editorial platforms, music-focused applications, or similar digital content environments.

    • Audience-Specific Writing: Experience adapting content for Gen Z audiences and contemporary pop culture communities is an advantage.

    • Assessment: Willingness to complete a skills assessment covering German grammar and music subject-matter expertise.

      • Benefits:

      • Competitive Hourly Compensation: Earn between $30 and $35 per hour, depending on the applicable engagement terms.

      • Music-Focused Work: Apply your passion for music and editorial expertise to content covering popular genres, artists, and cultural trends.

      • Flexible Work Environment: Contribute to a localization project through established digital tools and remote collaboration workflows, subject to the project's specific working arrangements.

      • Creative Contribution: Help shape the quality, authenticity, and cultural relevance of music-related content for German-speaking audiences.

      • AI and Language Innovation: Gain exposure to AI-generated content refinement and quality assurance within a professional localization environment.

      • Specialist Development: Further develop your expertise in music editorial work, localization, cultural adaptation, and content quality evaluation.

title: Punjabi Linguistic Evaluator & Functional Tester
description:
About Welocalize

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Punjabi speaker to join a confidential, large-scale AI and consumer technology programme for a major global technology and communications client.

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how the product actually performs on a client-supplied device — a smartphone and a next-generation smart glass. If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying.

Welocalize is looking for a native-level Punjabi speaker to join a large-scale AI and consumer technology programme.

It's a hands-on, on-site role that combines two things: evaluating a pre-release AI model in your language, and testing how it performs on a real device. You'll be among the first people to see this technology in Punjabi, and your judgement shapes how well it works before anyone else uses it.

If you enjoy noticing the detail other people miss, this is work you'll find satisfying.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Review pre-release AI model output in Punjabi and judge it on accuracy, naturalness, appropriateness, and overall quality — would a native speaker really say it this way? This includes fact-checking each response against the source material.

  • Test the Punjabi experience against the English one: confirm feature parity, complete a full user journey using non-English input, and check the product handles non-Latin script, diacritics, right-to-left text, and mixed-language input correctly.

  • Spot any display problem (text cut off, overflowing, or rendering badly) and any localization error — a wrong date, number, currency, unit, or a string left untranslated.

  • Write up each issue clearly so a developer can reproduce it: the step taken, the device and operating system, the locale, the build ID, and supporting evidence. Re-test once a fix lands to confirm it's resolved.

  • Share your perspective as a native-level speaker on navigation, usability, and the language-specific nuance only a fluent speaker would catch.

  • Work on-site in a private, secure area of the Welocalize office. Because of the confidential, pre-release nature of the technology, a remote or work-from-home arrangement isn't possible for this programme.

  • Support other linguistic projects as needed.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • Native-level or fully bilingual Punjabi, written and spoken, with a current feel for how the language is really used day-to-day — every day and technical.

  • Confidence with a smartphone and a laptop, and comfort moving between iOS and Android.

  • A sharp eye for detail and fair, objective judgement when assessing quality.

  • The ability to work independently, follow a detailed test script and guideline, and explain an issue clearly in English.

  • Previous experience in software or app testing, localization QA, or linguistic evaluation is a strong plus — though not essential if you bring the language skill and the attention to detail.

Welocalize helps the world's leading brands speak to a global audience — and language testing sits at the heart of that. You'll work alongside an experienced linguist and tester on technology most people won't see for months, in a team that takes quality and precision seriously.

If you're a native-level Punjabi speaker with an eye for detail and an interest in how language and technology meet, we'd like to hear from you.

title: German Music Localization Specialist
description:

Join a dynamic localization project focused on making music-related content engaging, accurate, and culturally relevant for German-speaking audiences.   • Cultural and Linguistic Adaptation: Adapt content to reflect the cultural nuances, language preferences, and expectations of the target audience while maintaining authenticity and relevance.
