  • Platform and Workflow Collaboration: Work with client-specific tools and editorial workflows to deliver consistent, high-quality content within established project requirements and timelines.

  • Pop Culture Awareness: Apply knowledge of mainstream music culture, popular artists, online trends, and contemporary expressions to ensure content resonates with its intended audience.

    • Requirements:

    • Copywriting Experience: Proven experience in copywriting, editing, or content creation, with the ability to produce polished, engaging, and audience-focused written material.

    • German Language Proficiency: Native-level fluency in German, with excellent grammar, spelling, punctuation, vocabulary, and stylistic awareness.

    • Music Content Expertise: Demonstrated experience writing or editing music-related content across multiple genres, with a strong understanding of the language and conventions used in music publishing and digital media.

    • Genre Knowledge: Deep familiarity with Pop, Rock, Hip-Hop, and K-Pop, including relevant artists, terminology, cultural references, and evolving trends.

    • Contemporary Music Awareness: Strong knowledge of the music industry and current music culture, including the ability to recognise relevant developments and distinguish accurate information from outdated or incorrect references.

    • Cultural and Editorial Sensitivity: Ability to adapt content to different musical contexts and audiences while maintaining cultural relevance, authenticity, and a natural tone of voice.

    • Pop Culture Fluency: A strong awareness of mainstream and emerging pop culture, including the expressions, references, and trends that resonate with contemporary audiences.

    • Attention to Detail: Excellent research, fact-checking, and proofreading skills, with the ability to identify inconsistencies and maintain accuracy across all content.

    • Adaptability and Creativity: Ability to adjust writing style and tone to meet different editorial requirements while keeping content engaging, clear, and natural.

    • Bonus Experience: Published music-related work in established publications such as Billboard, Rolling Stone, Pitchfork, NME, or comparable outlets.

    • Additional Advantage: Experience working with music streaming services, editorial platforms, music-focused applications, or similar digital content environments.

    • Audience-Specific Writing: Experience adapting content for Gen Z audiences and contemporary pop culture communities is an advantage.

    • Assessment: Willingness to complete a skills assessment covering German grammar and music subject-matter expertise.

      • Benefits:

      • Competitive Hourly Compensation: Earn between $30 and $35 per hour, depending on the applicable engagement terms.

      • Specialist Development: Further develop your expertise in music editorial work, localization, cultural adaptation, and content quality evaluation.

title: Director, Quality & Health Equity
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director, Quality & Health Equity based in the United States.

We are seeking an experienced healthcare leader to shape and advance quality improvement and health equity strategies across diverse patient populations. In this role, you will drive initiatives that improve clinical outcomes, reduce health disparities, manage costs, and enhance the overall value of care delivered through value-based healthcare programs. You will use clinical, claims, demographic, and social data to identify improvement opportunities and develop targeted interventions that promote equitable access and better patient experiences. Working closely with clinical leaders, analytics teams, healthcare providers, payers, and community partners, you will translate strategic priorities into measurable results. You will also lead and develop a team of quality improvement professionals while fostering a collaborative and inclusive culture. This is an opportunity to influence healthcare transformation and help build a more equitable, effective, and patient-centered system.

Accountabilities

  • Develop and lead comprehensive quality improvement and health equity strategies, including multi-year strategic plans and annual work plans aligned with organizational objectives and value-based care commitments.

  • Identify opportunities to improve health outcomes, enhance care quality, reduce avoidable costs, and increase value across Medicaid, Medicare, Medicare Advantage, and commercial populations.

  • Use clinical, claims, demographic, and social data to identify variations in performance and disparities across race, ethnicity, language, disability, geography, and other relevant population characteristics.

  • Design, implement, and evaluate targeted interventions that address health disparities, improve access to care, and support culturally responsive, patient-centered healthcare delivery.

  • Oversee quality improvement and health equity programs, establishing performance goals and monitoring progress against quality measures, contractual requirements, cost targets, and equity objectives.

  • Collaborate with clinical and operational leaders, analytics and IT teams, payers, network providers, and community organizations to align priorities and deliver sustainable improvement initiatives.

  • Translate complex data into actionable insights, recommendations, and performance reports that support executive decision-making and guide clinical and operational improvements.

  • Partner with analytics and IT teams to develop reliable reporting tools, dashboards, and ad hoc analyses that support quality measurement, population health management, and health equity initiatives.

  • Ensure data accuracy, appropriate reporting, and compliance with HIPAA, applicable regulations, contractual obligations, and organizational policies.

  • Lead, supervise, coach, and develop quality improvement staff, overseeing recruitment, onboarding, performance management, professional development, and annual evaluations.

  • Establish clear expectations for team productivity, quality assurance, accountability, and timely delivery of program objectives while promoting collaboration and inclusion.

title: German Music Localization Specialist
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a German Music Localization Specialist based in Belgium.

Join a dynamic localization project focused on making music-related content engaging, accurate, and culturally relevant for German-speaking audiences. In this role, you will refine, edit, and fact-check AI-generated content while ensuring it reflects authentic music terminology, current trends, and the language of contemporary pop culture. You will work across a variety of musical genres, including Pop, Rock, Hip-Hop, and K-Pop, helping deliver high-quality content across digital and audiovisual platforms. Combining creative writing expertise with cultural insight, you will improve content clarity, consistency, and overall editorial quality. This opportunity is ideal for a music enthusiast with a strong editorial voice who understands how language, artists, and cultural references connect with audiences. Your expertise will help shape more natural, engaging, and locally relevant music experiences.

Accountabilities

  • Content Review and Editing: Review, edit, refine, and fact-check music-related content in German, ensuring accuracy, clarity, coherence, and compliance with established editorial guidelines.

  • AI-Generated Content Enhancement: Improve US English source content generated by AI, refining its wording, structure, tone, and creative impact to produce engaging and natural German-language content.

  • Music Research and Fact-Checking: Conduct market-specific research into music terminology, artists, genres, industry conventions, and emerging trends to ensure content is accurate and up to date.

  • Cultural and Linguistic Adaptation: Adapt content to reflect the cultural nuances, language preferences, and expectations of the target audience while maintaining authenticity and relevance.

  • Editorial Quality Assurance: Ensure consistency, readability, and high editorial standards across digital and audiovisual platforms, following project-specific style guides and quality requirements.

  • Tone of Voice Optimisation: Tailor writing styles to different musical genres, audiences, and contexts, avoiding overly formal or artificial language in favour of an engaging, contemporary voice.

  • Content Feedback and Improvement: Provide clear, constructive feedback on written content, identify areas for improvement, and contribute to continuous quality enhancement.

  • Platform and Workflow Collaboration: Work with client-specific tools and editorial workflows to deliver consistent, high-quality content within established project requirements and timelines.

  • Pop Culture Awareness: Apply knowledge of mainstream music culture, popular artists, online trends, and contemporary expressions to ensure content resonates with its intended audience.

    • Requirements:

    • Copywriting Experience: Proven experience in copywriting, editing, or content creation, with the ability to produce polished, engaging, and audience-focused written material.

    • German Language Proficiency: Native-level fluency in German, with excellent grammar, spelling, punctuation, vocabulary, and stylistic awareness.

    • Music Content Expertise: Demonstrated experience writing or editing music-related content across multiple genres, with a strong understanding of the language and conventions used in music publishing and digital media.

    • Genre Knowledge: Deep familiarity with Pop, Rock, Hip-Hop, and K-Pop, including relevant artists, terminology, cultural references, and evolving trends.

    • Contemporary Music Awareness: Strong knowledge of the music industry and current music culture, including the ability to recognise relevant developments and distinguish accurate information from outdated or incorrect references.

    • Cultural and Editorial Sensitivity: Ability to adapt content to different musical contexts and audiences while maintaining cultural relevance, authenticity, and a natural tone of voice.

    • Pop Culture Fluency: A strong awareness of mainstream and emerging pop culture, including the expressions, references, and trends that resonate with contemporary audiences.

    • Attention to Detail: Excellent research, fact-checking, and proofreading skills, with the ability to identify inconsistencies and maintain accuracy across all content.

    • Adaptability and Creativity: Ability to adjust writing style and tone to meet different editorial requirements while keeping content engaging, clear, and natural.

    • Bonus Experience: Published music-related work in established publications such as Billboard, Rolling Stone, Pitchfork, NME, or comparable outlets.

    • Additional Advantage: Experience working with music streaming services, editorial platforms, music-focused applications, or similar digital content environments.

    • Audience-Specific Writing: Experience adapting content for Gen Z audiences and contemporary pop culture communities is an advantage.

    • Assessment: Willingness to complete a skills assessment covering German grammar and music subject-matter expertise.

      • Benefits:

      • Competitive Hourly Compensation: Earn between $30 and $35 per hour, depending on the applicable engagement terms.

      • Music-Focused Work: Apply your passion for music and editorial expertise to content covering popular genres, artists, and cultural trends.

      • Flexible Work Environment: Contribute to a localization project through established digital tools and remote collaboration workflows, subject to the project's specific working arrangements.

      • Creative Contribution: Help shape the quality, authenticity, and cultural relevance of music-related content for German-speaking audiences.

      • AI and Language Innovation: Gain exposure to AI-generated content refinement and quality assurance within a professional localization environment.

      • Specialist Development: Further develop your expertise in music editorial work, localization, cultural adaptation, and content quality evaluation.

title: AI Developer (Python/ Django)
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a skilled Python / Django Developer with strong full-stack development experience and a passion for AI-assisted software development. You will build and maintain web applications, client automations, and SaaS products using Python, Django, and Claude Code.

This role goes beyond traditional software development. You will translate client requirements into clear specifications and step-by-step implementation plans, use AI coding tools to build features efficiently, and critically review, test, and refine the generated code to ensure quality and reliability.

You will work with an established application foundation and a library of reusable components, prioritising existing solutions over unnecessary redevelopment. The ideal candidate combines strong technical fundamentals with sound engineering judgement, attention to detail, and the ability to identify and correct AI-generated code that does not meet requirements.

About the Client

You will be working with an Australian software consultancy that develops business automation solutions and SaaS products. The organisation helps businesses streamline document-heavy processes involving invoices, emails, spreadsheets, and other operational workflows.

The team follows a structured, AI-assisted development approach, using established application foundations, reusable software components, and systematic testing to deliver reliable solutions efficiently. This is an opportunity to contribute to practical software products while developing expertise in AI-assisted engineering practices.

Ideal Profile

Core Development Experience

  • At least 3 years of professional full-stack development experience, including a minimum of two years working with Python and Django.
  • Strong understanding of Django fundamentals, including ORM, models, migrations, views, forms, templates, and the Django admin interface.
  • Experience working with PostgreSQL and writing accurate, efficient database queries.
  • Practical experience developing, maintaining, and debugging web applications.

AI-Assisted Development

  • Regular, hands-on use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar platforms.
  • Ability to review AI-generated code critically, identify errors, and make appropriate corrections.
  • Experience translating requirements into clear technical specifications and implementation plans before development.
  • A strong preference for reusable components and existing solutions rather than unnecessary custom development.
  • Willingness to use AI tools for code generation, testing, and documentation while maintaining responsibility for code quality.

Testing & Engineering Practices

  • Experience writing and maintaining automated tests, with a strong commitment to test-driven quality practices.
  • Confidence using Git, pull requests, and code reviews.
  • Ability to troubleshoot issues systematically and ensure tests pass throughout development.
  • Understanding of secure coding practices, particularly permissions, multi-tenant data, and safe file uploads.

Communication & Work Management

  • Strong written English, with the ability to prepare clear specifications, development plans, handover notes, and client updates.
  • Good organisational skills and the ability to work independently from agreed plans.
  • A commitment to honest progress reporting, timely escalation of blockers, and clear documentation.
  • A proactive approach to identifying reusable improvements and preventing recurring defects.

Desirable Experience

  • Advanced familiarity with Claude Code, including skills, plans, and subagents.
  • Experience with SaaS Pegasus or similar Django starter kits.
  • Knowledge of Tailwind CSS, HTMX, and Alpine.js.
  • Experience with Celery, Redis, and background processing.
  • Familiarity with Stripe, Xero, Microsoft Graph, Microsoft 365, and SharePoint integrations.
  • Experience with Docker, Render, or Azure Container Apps.

title: German Music Localization Specialist
description:

Join a dynamic localization project focused on making music-related content engaging, accurate, and culturally relevant for German-speaking audiences. In this role, you will refine, edit, and fact-check AI-generated content while ensuring it reflects authentic music terminology, current trends, and the language of contemporary pop culture. You will work across a variety of musical genres, including Pop, Rock, Hip-Hop, and K-Pop, helping deliver high-quality content across digital and audiovisual platforms.   • Music Research and Fact-Checking: Conduct market-specific research into music terminology, artists, genres, industry conventions, and emerging trends to ensure content is accurate and up to date.

  • Cultural and Linguistic Adaptation: Adapt content to reflect the cultural nuances, language preferences, and expectations of the target audience while maintaining authenticity and relevance.

  • Content Feedback and Improvement: Provide clear, constructive feedback on written content, identify areas for improvement, and contribute to continuous quality enhancement.

  • Platform and Workflow Collaboration: Work with client-specific tools and editorial workflows to deliver consistent, high-quality content within established project requirements and timelines.

  • Pop Culture Awareness: Apply knowledge of mainstream music culture, popular artists, online trends, and contemporary expressions to ensure content resonates with its intended audience.

    • Requirements:

    • Copywriting Experience: Proven experience in copywriting, editing, or content creation, with the ability to produce polished, engaging, and audience-focused written material.

    • German Language Proficiency: Native-level fluency in German, with excellent grammar, spelling, punctuation, vocabulary, and stylistic awareness.

    • Music Content Expertise: Demonstrated experience writing or editing music-related content across multiple genres, with a strong understanding of the language and conventions used in music publishing and digital media.

    • Contemporary Music Awareness: Strong knowledge of the music industry and current music culture, including the ability to recognise relevant developments and distinguish accurate information from outdated or incorrect references.

    • Cultural and Editorial Sensitivity: Ability to adapt content to different musical contexts and audiences while maintaining cultural relevance, authenticity, and a natural tone of voice.

    • Pop Culture Fluency: A strong awareness of mainstream and emerging pop culture, including the expressions, references, and trends that resonate with contemporary audiences.

    • Attention to Detail: Excellent research, fact-checking, and proofreading skills, with the ability to identify inconsistencies and maintain accuracy across all content.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Python & Distributed Systems)
description:
Job Title: Senior Software Engineer (Python & Distributed Systems)

Location: Cambridgeshire, UK (5 days onsite – Central Cambridge & Bourn Quarter)

Contract Length: 12 Months

Overview

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to support and scale software systems inside our Cambridge data collection lab. You will build and integrate backend services for cutting-edge prototype wearables, handling multi-modal sensor streams (audio, video, IMU) to ensure data collection is fast, accurate, and reliable.

Key Responsibilities
  • Develop backend services to integrate prototype wearable devices into data collection pipelines.
  • Deploy, monitor, and optimize distributed systems ingesting real-time sensor modalities.
  • Build automated tooling for data validation, system health, and pipeline diagnostics.
  • Provide onsite troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and network debugging in a live lab environment.
  • Collaborate with audio/video engineers, technicians, and international research teams.
Requirements
  • Python: 8+ years of professional backend software engineering and data processing experience.
  • Linux & Automation: Strong Linux systems knowledge and shell scripting (Bash).
  • Networking & Distributed Systems: Solid understanding of IP networking (IPv4/IPv6, VLANs, routing) and building RESTful/concurrent distributed systems.
  • APIs: Practical experience with modern frameworks like FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
  • Work Arrangement: 100% onsite in Cambridgeshire across central Cambridge and Bourn Quarter facilities.

title: German Music Localization Specialist
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a German Music Localization Specialist based in Poland.

Join a dynamic localization project focused on making music-related content engaging, accurate, and culturally relevant for German-speaking audiences. In this role, you will refine, edit, and fact-check AI-generated content while ensuring it reflects authentic music terminology, current trends, and the language of contemporary pop culture. You will work across a variety of musical genres, including Pop, Rock, Hip-Hop, and K-Pop, helping deliver high-quality content across digital and audiovisual platforms. Combining creative writing expertise with cultural insight, you will improve content clarity, consistency, and overall editorial quality. This opportunity is ideal for a music enthusiast with a strong editorial voice who understands how language, artists, and cultural references connect with audiences. Your expertise will help shape more natural, engaging, and locally relevant music experiences.

Accountabilities

  • Content Review and Editing: Review, edit, refine, and fact-check music-related content in German, ensuring accuracy, clarity, coherence, and compliance with established editorial guidelines.

  • AI-Generated Content Enhancement: Improve US English source content generated by AI, refining its wording, structure, tone, and creative impact to produce engaging and natural German-language content.

  • Music Research and Fact-Checking: Conduct market-specific research into music terminology, artists, genres, industry conventions, and emerging trends to ensure content is accurate and up to date.

  • Cultural and Linguistic Adaptation: Adapt content to reflect the cultural nuances, language preferences, and expectations of the target audience while maintaining authenticity and relevance.

  • Editorial Quality Assurance: Ensure consistency, readability, and high editorial standards across digital and audiovisual platforms, following project-specific style guides and quality requirements.

  • Tone of Voice Optimisation: Tailor writing styles to different musical genres, audiences, and contexts, avoiding overly formal or artificial language in favour of an engaging, contemporary voice.

  • Content Feedback and Improvement: Provide clear, constructive feedback on written content, identify areas for improvement, and contribute to continuous quality enhancement.

  • Platform and Workflow Collaboration: Work with client-specific tools and editorial workflows to deliver consistent, high-quality content within established project requirements and timelines.

  • Pop Culture Awareness: Apply knowledge of mainstream music culture, popular artists, online trends, and contemporary expressions to ensure content resonates with its intended audience.

    • Requirements:

    • Copywriting Experience: Proven experience in copywriting, editing, or content creation, with the ability to produce polished, engaging, and audience-focused written material.

    • German Language Proficiency: Native-level fluency in German, with excellent grammar, spelling, punctuation, vocabulary, and stylistic awareness.

    • Music Content Expertise: Demonstrated experience writing or editing music-related content across multiple genres, with a strong understanding of the language and conventions used in music publishing and digital media.

    • Genre Knowledge: Deep familiarity with Pop, Rock, Hip-Hop, and K-Pop, including relevant artists, terminology, cultural references, and evolving trends.

    • Contemporary Music Awareness: Strong knowledge of the music industry and current music culture, including the ability to recognise relevant developments and distinguish accurate information from outdated or incorrect references.

    • Cultural and Editorial Sensitivity: Ability to adapt content to different musical contexts and audiences while maintaining cultural relevance, authenticity, and a natural tone of voice.

    • Pop Culture Fluency: A strong awareness of mainstream and emerging pop culture, including the expressions, references, and trends that resonate with contemporary audiences.

    • Attention to Detail: Excellent research, fact-checking, and proofreading skills, with the ability to identify inconsistencies and maintain accuracy across all content.

    • Adaptability and Creativity: Ability to adjust writing style and tone to meet different editorial requirements while keeping content engaging, clear, and natural.

    • Bonus Experience: Published music-related work in established publications such as Billboard, Rolling Stone, Pitchfork, NME, or comparable outlets.

    • Additional Advantage: Experience working with music streaming services, editorial platforms, music-focused applications, or similar digital content environments.

    • Audience-Specific Writing: Experience adapting content for Gen Z audiences and contemporary pop culture communities is an advantage.

    • Assessment: Willingness to complete a skills assessment covering German grammar and music subject-matter expertise.

      • Benefits:

      • Competitive Hourly Compensation: Earn between $30 and $35 per hour, depending on the applicable engagement terms.

      • Music-Focused Work: Apply your passion for music and editorial expertise to content covering popular genres, artists, and cultural trends.

      • Flexible Work Environment: Contribute to a localization project through established digital tools and remote collaboration workflows, subject to the project's specific working arrangements.

      • Creative Contribution: Help shape the quality, authenticity, and cultural relevance of music-related content for German-speaking audiences.

      • AI and Language Innovation: Gain exposure to AI-generated content refinement and quality assurance within a professional localization environment.

      • Specialist Development: Further develop your expertise in music editorial work, localization, cultural adaptation, and content quality evaluation.

description:
Work format: remote from anywhere in the world or from one of our European offices. The company hires specialists who have already relocated from Russia or Belarus.

Overview

Our company is looking for a Network Security Engineer to join our Team. Our Security Team takes care of iGaming services protection, data privacy, and business continuity to ensure that nothing distracts satisfied customers from using our products. We work closely with the IT team that develops and supports our services, and together we create genuinely excellent and secure iGaming products.

Purpose of the role

In this role, you will design, implement, and maintain secure, scalable, and reliable network security infrastructure across the company. You will strengthen corporate and cloud network security, improve security standards and automation, and help ensure the resilience and protection of the company’s infrastructure against modern security threats.

Key responsibilities

  • Maintain and develop the corporate VPN infrastructure.
  • Maintain and improve Next-Generation Firewall infrastructure across the company.
  • Own and drive the implementation of network security controls and best practices.
  • Design, optimize, and secure network architectures.
  • Manage network security within cloud environments.
  • Integrate and deploy network and security equipment.
  • Contribute to the development of security policies and standards.
  • Automate routine network security and operational tasks.

Required Experience

  • 3+ years of experience as a Network Security Engineer or Network Engineer.
  • Deep knowledge and understanding of Palo Alto architecture and specifics.
  • Hands-on experience with modern VPN solutions.
  • Experience with Firewalls/Next-Generation Firewalls and understanding of nftables/iptables and core firewall principles.

  • Deep knowledge of Linux-based operating systems, including the networking stack.
  • Experience with Public Cloud technologies (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Oracle Cloud), specifically networking and security implementations.
  • Solid understanding of routing protocols such as BGP and OSPF.
  • Strong knowledge of OSI layers (L2/L3/L4/L7), common network architectures, Firewalls, and IDS/IPS environments.
  • Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible, SaltStack).
  • Experience with network monitoring and observability tools, including NetFlow/IPFIX traffic analysis.
  • Experience with automation using Python or Go.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • English level B2 or higher.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with VMware NSX, OpenStack Neutron, Docker, Kubernetes, Istio, or similar technologies.
  • Knowledge of IAM, SSO, OpenID, and SAML authentication technologies.

description:

  • Platform and Workflow Collaboration: Work with client-specific tools and editorial workflows to deliver consistent, high-quality content within established project requirements and timelines.

  • Pop Culture Awareness: Apply knowledge of mainstream music culture, popular artists, online trends, and contemporary expressions to ensure content resonates with its intended audience.

    • Requirements:

    • Copywriting Experience: Proven experience in copywriting, editing, or content creation, with the ability to produce polished, engaging, and audience-focused written material.

    • Bonus Experience: Published music-related work in established publications such as Billboard, Rolling Stone, Pitchfork, NME, or comparable outlets.

    • Additional Advantage: Experience working with music streaming services, editorial platforms, music-focused applications, or similar digital content environments.
